entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Annie. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago.
Okay, I can certainly help you with a return. Can I get your order number, please?
It's #VF789234. Look, I don't have all day. I just want to send this thing back. It's not what I expected.

Thank you. I have your order here for the VeloBand Pulse. So you’d like to initiate a return. No problem at all! Our return policy states that you have 90 days to return items for a full refund, as long as they’re in good condition.

90 days? Great! Because it’s been, like, 15 days since I bought it. This VeloBand Pulse is useless. It doesn’t track my sleep accurately at all! What’s the point of a smart watch if it can’t even do that?

I understand your frustration. Sleep tracking is a very important feature for many users. Since you're well within our 90-day return policy, I can go ahead and process a return for you. I'll send you a prepaid shipping label via email. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse securely and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Finally! So I’ll get my money back, right? I just need this over with. Honestly, the whole thing has been a waste of time. And I'm never buying anything from you again.

Yes, once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, just send the label. And make sure the refund goes through this time! Seriously! I shouldn't have to wait another 10 days. I bought a different smart watch from somewhere else and am much happier

I completely understand. I've already initiated the process, and you'll receive the shipping label within the next hour. We appreciate your patience. To clarify, our standard return policy offers 90 days for most returns, and this VeloBand Pulse falls under that umbrella. If you do have any further questions or concerns regarding the return, you are welcome to call back.
